title: representative late game, long: RG-002 extended, a state-edited AIX 2461 after one settling year, six expert computer players and a JOAT player giving client orders, 2462 to 2474 chained (12 years) with every player's orders

source.experiment: stars-oracle-apparatus evidence/rg003 (private); start from RG-002's start (a state-edited AIX 2461 after one settling year)

cases.setup: year 1 of the chain (NOT an unedited played game. Years 1 to 6 are RG-002's recorded years, unchanged (same files, same orders; experiments/rg002 lists every start edit). Years 7 to 12 continue from RG-002 year 6 the same way: player 0's orders written by the original client from commands lane F chose (injected, not original AIX play; experiments/rg003 lists them), the computer players planned from the current files, then the year was generated with every order file supplied, so the host ran no computer player and the stream starts at seeding)
cases.verdict: recorded, no prediction committed; samples flagged from 2 other streams
